items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment and continue only the existing period-aligned reconciliation. Authorize no discretionary spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, requeues, or new production work. Supported revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The aggregate row is not site-attributable; site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. AI usage reports $973.3548129 across 5,439 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27, conflicting with retained records of $966.82985915 across 5,417 calls through 2026-09-26 and $963.5690377 across 5,390 calls. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable: revenue and cost windows are misaligned, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing costs are absent or incomplete, and no monthly spend limit, revenue target, or budget is provided. Minimum measurements are period-aligned site/content-attributable revenue; reconciled AI, infrastructure, domain, marketing, and allocated labor costs; and a defined incremental learning outcome with its attributable cost. SEO impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, performance scores, and AI calls are not financial returns and must not support revenue forecasts or spend decisions. Preserve the existing CFO reconciliation work item; create no duplicate finance request.
